The air rippled.
	As if the world about them were nothing more than a curtain to be yanked aside, four figures warped into existence before their very eyes, all moredhel and all armed. One of the assassins, dressed in finer wear than the three who flanked him, bared his teeth as he spoke.  "óGorath, ólwychan óchoi ónekkad ósedu óDelekhan! Baka'al eledhel!"
	"Gorath?" @4 glanced questioningly at his companion, watching as the moredhel withdrew his own weapon, his black gaze fixed on the others of his kind arrayed before them.
	"Defend yourself," Gorath rasped coldly. "No moss trooper this, but a ósorcerer. Nago. Of those that are said to have served Delekhan before the coming of the Six, he is known as the most powerful magician of my kin. Only we three or he and his will see the next morn..."�

	「戈拉斯？」@4疑惑地瞥了一眼同伴，只見那莫瑞德人拔出了自己的武器，漆黑的目光緊盯著眼前排開的同族。
	「準備應戰，」戈拉斯冷冷地啞聲道。「這可不是普通的荒野游兵，而是一名ó法師。納戈。據說在六賢者到來之前曾效力於迪勒肯，是我族中公認最強大的法師。今夜，恐怕只有我們三人或他們一行能活著看見明天的日出…」�

	「搜搜屍體，也許有值錢的補給，」@4提議，接著補充：「動作快點。要是外頭還有埋伏，可別讓他們逮個正著。」�

entries.source:
The creatures had ñvanishedð.
	Fearful the creatures might appear from behind, @1 spun, but found the menacing apparitions had indeed disappeared back to wherever they had come from.
	"They're gone," he said, his voice still raw from exertion. "Let's get moving again."�
entries.translation:
那些生物ñ消失ð了。
	深怕那些生物會從背後冒出，@1猛地轉身，卻發現那些懾人的幻影確實已消失回原本的地方。
	「牠們走了，」他說，聲音因方才的力竭而仍帶著沙啞。「我們繼續走吧。」�

entries.source:
The battle was won.
	"Search the body for supplies," @4 suggested, then amended, "but make it quick. If there are more waiting out there, let's not be here when they return."�
entries.translation:
這場戰鬥贏了。
	「搜搜屍體找補給，」@4提議，接著補充：「動作快點。要是外頭還有埋伏，可別讓他們逮個正著。」�

entries.source:
@4 blinked.
	Despite the fact the creature had disappeared he was wary to drop his guard, but a quick survey of the area revealed that it was nowhere in sight. "I think it's gone," he said. "Let's get moving again."�
entries.translation:
@4眨了眨眼。
	儘管那生物已經消失，他仍不敢鬆懈，但快速環顧四周後確認它已不見蹤影。「我想牠走了，」他說。「我們繼續走吧。」�

entries.source:
The enemy had fled.
	"I don't like the way this feels," @4 said. "It's possible there are more lying in wait for us. Let's make sure we aren't here should they decide to come for us."�
entries.translation:
敵人逃跑了。
	「我不太喜歡這種感覺，」@4說。「說不定還有更多敵人埋伏著。要是他們回頭找我們，最好確保我們早已不在這裡。」�

entries.source:
A gasp escaped @'s lips as he levered himself into an upright position and looked over his wounds.
	"I think I'll amend the plan," @ said. "My wounds are mortal. You go on without me..."
	"No one gets left behind," @1 shot back angrily. "No one! Get your things and we move. We'll find a healer for you along the way who can help."�

@ gasped.
	Pain sapping his strength, he was unable to rise from the ground, but dimly he perceived his attacker moving closer, perhaps to finish him off, perhaps for some other less savory purpose.
	"Bastard..," @4 whispered, his vision beginning to dim. "Lims-Kragma...curse...ñyouð..."
	Death came swiftly...�
entries.translation:
@倒抽一口氣。
	劇痛耗盡了他的力氣，他爬不起身，卻隱約感覺攻擊者正逐漸逼近，或許是要了結他，或許另有更不堪的打算。
	「混帳…」@4低語，視線漸漸模糊。「願林絲克拉格瑪…詛咒ñ你ð…」
	死亡來得很快…�

entries.source:
They ran.
	@3 cursed the tendency his feet had to find bumps and sinkholes, but he stumbled on, terrified at the notion he would never find safety, never have another moment in his life when someone didn't wish to carve him up alive. It was a numbing thought, but he moved on until he reached his companions and safety.�
entries.translation:
他們拔腿就跑。
	@3咒罵自己的腳總愛踩到坑坑洞洞，但他跌跌撞撞繼續前進，心中滿是恐懼——生怕自己再也找不到安全之地，再也沒有一刻不被人惦記著要活活宰了他。這念頭令人麻木，但他仍奮力前行，直到與同伴會合、脫離險境。�

entries.source:
It felt shameful.
	For a moment he had entertained the thought of running, of turning about and never placing his life in harm's way again for people or things he cared about. He wished only to be away from the horrid spectacle, but the motionless form of his companion lay bleeding on the ground. He could not abandon his friend to certain death.�
entries.translation:
這感覺很可恥。
	有那麼一刻，他動了逃跑的念頭——轉身離開，再也不為在乎的人或事以身犯險。他只想遠離這幅可怕的景象，但同伴一動不動地倒在地上、血流不止。他無法拋下朋友，任其送死。�

entries.source:
They were trapped.
	With the sound of his heart pounding in his ears, @4 forced himself to pause... forced himself to think clearly for a moment; an action that lasted mere seconds but felt like lifetimes. Taking stock of their situation he quickly realized escape would be futile.
	Retreat, for the moment at least, was out of the question.�
entries.translation:
他們被困住了。
	心跳聲在耳中轟鳴，@4逼自己停下…逼自己冷靜思考片刻；這僅僅幾秒的舉動卻彷彿過了一輩子那麼長。盤點局勢後，他很快意識到逃跑是徒勞的。
	至少此刻，撤退是不可能的。�

entries.source:
Retreat was out of the question.
	It would be all too easy for others to be lying in wait on their flank. Caught between the two ranks, they would be harried from both sides until their defenses collapsed.
	"Forward ñthrough them is the only way," @4 said decisively. "Even if there isn't another group waiting, there may be something they're trying to keep us from reaching."�
entries.translation:
撤退是不可能的。
	側翼很可能還有其他敵人埋伏。一旦被前後夾擊，他們將腹背受敵，直至防線崩潰。
	「唯一的路就是ñ正面突破，」@4果斷地說。「就算沒有另一批敵人埋伏，他們攔著我們，恐怕也是不想讓我們接近某樣東西。」�

These couldn't be wider than three. There could be an ambush ahead. If we proceed in the direction we are currently heading we should do so with great caution.�

The shovel gleamed.
	They were about to begin digging when @0 held up his hand. He bent down near the base of the tombstone and retrieved a small red ball, which he rolled between his forefinger and thumb.
	"Wax," he said after a few seconds. "Someone has been burning candles over this grave...perhaps wanting to drive away an evil spirit. If we continue to dig here, I suggest we be prepared for the consequences."�
entries.translation:
鏟子閃著微光。
	他們正要開始挖掘，@0卻舉手示意暫停。他在墓碑底部彎下腰，撿起一顆紅色小球，在食指與拇指間搓動。
	「是蠟，」片刻後他說道。「有人在這座墳上點過蠟燭…或許是想驅趕惡靈。要是我們繼續挖，我建議做好承擔後果的準備。」�

A bird shot into the sky.
	Searching the landscape for the source of the animal's discomfort, @0 whispered...�
entries.translation:
一隻鳥倏地飛上天空。
	環顧四周尋找那動物驚慌的源頭，@0低聲道…�

Son of the Baron of Land's End, Locklear has achieved great notoriety while serving Arutha conDoin, Prince of Krondor. Decorated for his service at the battles of Armengar and Sethanon during the war known as the Great Rising, he is one of the most honored nobles at the court of Krondor and in many respects is considered an unofficial member of the royal family.
	In the ninth year of the reign of King Lyam I, Locklear entered the service of a northern Kingdom garrison to investigate reports of a conflict raging in the Northlands. Shortly after his arrival, his military escort was attacked by moredhel raiders and Locklear found himself cut off from his companions. Later, upon seeing someone fleeing a moredhel warrior, Locklear slew the aggressor only to discover the man he had saved was in fact a moredhel himself, Gorath of the Ardanien Clan.�
entries.translation:
洛克利爾紳爵是陸地盡頭男爵之子，因效力於克朗多親王亞魯莎康多因而聲名遠播。在被稱為「大崛起之戰」的戰事中，他因阿曼加與賽瑟儂兩役的戰功獲頒勳章，是克朗多宮廷中最受敬重的貴族之一，在許多方面幾乎被視為王室的非正式一員。
	在萊亞姆一世登基第九年，洛克利爾奉命前往北方一處王國駐防要塞，調查北境戰事頻傳的消息。抵達不久後，他的護衛隊便遭莫瑞德劫掠者襲擊，洛克利爾與同伴失散。後來，他見到有人正被一名莫瑞德戰士追殺，出手殺了那名攻擊者，這才發現自己救下的人竟是莫瑞德人——阿爾達尼恩氏族的戈拉斯。�

entries.source:
Although he is an eligible claimant to the moredhel throne in Sar-Sargoth, Gorath has never desired to meddle in the politics of the Northlands, but often he has had little choice. He has been notably vocal in his criticism of the leadership of Delekhan, a moredhel who distinguished himself during the Great Rising as one of Murmandamus' field generals and later claimed the throne of Sar-Sargoth for his own.
	Gorath himself has led an impressive military career and during the Riftwar, he directed one of the only moredhel defensives to successfully withstand Tsurani aggression. As he beat back invaders, thousands of moredhel escaped their homes in the Green Heart forest to the safety offered by the Northlands. Only starvation and superior Tsurani numbers eventually drove Gorath and his tribe of the Ardanien to flee across the Great Northern Mountains to their waiting cousins.�
entries.translation:
儘管戈拉斯有資格角逐薩薩戈斯的莫瑞德王座，他從未想插手北境的政治，但往往身不由己。他曾多次公開批評迪勒肯的領導——這名莫瑞德人在大崛起之戰中身為穆爾曼達穆斯麾下的一員大將而嶄露頭角，後來自立為薩薩戈斯之王。
	戈拉斯本人戰功彪炳，裂界之戰期間，他率領少數幾支成功抵擋圖蘭尼侵略的莫瑞德防線之一。在他擊退入侵者的同時，數千名莫瑞德人得以從綠心林的家園逃往北境尋求庇護。最終，只因糧食短缺與圖蘭尼人數上的優勢，才迫使戈拉斯與他的阿爾達尼恩部族翻越大北山脈，投奔在彼端等候的同族。�

entries.source:
More often than not, Owyn Beleforte has been a political embarrassment to his father, the Count of Tiburn. As a result, he has been given a degree of freedom even his elder brothers are envious of, though his father hopes he will one day settle down enough to become a marriageable suitor for the daughter of the Duke of Euper. Far craftier than he is often given credit for, Owyn has a keen eye for detail and can often see patterns invisible to those around him.
	All his life, Owyn has dreamed of studying magic and on many occasions has set elaborate plots in motion to spend time with masters of the arcane crafts. He undertook his most notable endeavor when he was only fourteen and vacationing in the city of Ran. Having spent the previous summer needling the household staff about his father's accounts, Owyn discovered a means of redirecting a portion of his father's wealth and managed to hire a magical tutor for nearly seven months. Finally his father detected his activities and recalled him home to Tiburn. Thereafter the Beleforte household staff was ordered to strict silence while in master Owyn's presence.�
entries.translation:
歐文貝勒佛特多半是他父親——提伯恩伯爵——政治上的一大尷尬。因此，他被賦予了連兄長們都眼紅的自由，儘管他父親仍希望他有朝一日能定下心來，迎娶尤帕公爵的女兒。歐文其實遠比外界認為的更精明，觀察入微，常能看出旁人渾然不覺的規律。
	歐文畢生夢想著鑽研法術，屢次精心策劃，只為爭取與奧秘之術的大師相處的機會。他最出名的一次壯舉發生在十四歲那年、於蘭城度假期間。前一個夏天他一直纏著管家打聽父親帳目的細節，這次他找到辦法挪用了一部分父親的財產，成功聘請了一位法術家教長達近七個月。最後他父親察覺了他的行動，把他召回提伯恩。此後，貝勒佛特家的僕役都被下令，在歐文少爺面前一律三緘其口。�

entries.source: Orphaned at a young age, Pug was raised in the kitchens of Crydee in the Western Empire. Apprenticed to Kulgan the magician, he showed little magical promise initially. Pug was captured and enslaved by the Tsurani during the Riftwar. Seeing vast potential in the boy, the Great Ones of the Tsurani Empire began to train him in the magic of the Greater Path. When Pug returned to Midkemia, he helped bring an end to the Riftwar with the help of Macros the Black. He was adopted into the royal family and awarded land to begin his Academy of Magic at Stardock. His irresistible friendliness belies the fact that he is the unchallenged master of magic in Midkemia. Pug is the father of two, an adopted daughter, Gamina, who possesses telepathic powers, and William, his natural son.�
entries.translation: 帕格自幼便成了孤兒，在西方王國的克萊迪廚房中長大。他拜法師庫爾根為師，起初展現不出多少法術天賦。裂界之戰期間，帕格被圖蘭尼人俘虜、淪為奴隸。圖蘭尼帝國的至尊法師們看出這個男孩身懷莫大潛力，開始傳授他大道法術。帕格重返米德凱米亞後，在黑袍馬克羅斯的協助下助力終結了裂界之戰。他被王室收為養子，並獲賜一塊土地，在星塢島建立了自己的法術學院。他那令人難以抗拒的親和力，掩蓋了他其實是米德凱米亞無可爭議的法術宗師這個事實。帕格育有二子女：領養的女兒蓋米娜擁有心靈感應能力，親生的兒子則名叫威廉。�

entries.source: Once known as Jimmy the Hand, Seigneur James is the son of the Upright Man, the leader of the thieves' guild in Krondor, though James is not aware of his true heritage. His thieving skills and quickness were legendary, but now, elevated to the nobility by Prince Arutha, Seigneur James has taken his position of authority very seriously, though he still wanders his old thief haunts in disguise...on occasion. He is extremely loyal to Arutha, and will do anything his liege lord asks him to do.�

entries.source:
Before the days of Pug's Academy of Magic at Stardock, Patrus was kept busy with the buzzing questions of his young apprentices. Now he finds himself without students, a fact that bothers him more than he cares to admit. From time to time he is called upon to work some minor magic or another, but few tasks truly challenge his abilities.
	Although Patrus seems addle-brained at times, his is numbered among the most capable magicians in Midkemia. Wrinkled as yesterday's laundry, his face is greatly expressive. Although he is balding, the sides of his head still foster white wisps of hair and his pointed chin is covered with a haze of beard. He walks with a slight hunch, is still fairly spry for his age and has no problem keeping up with his younger companions.�

在帕格於星塢島創立法術學院之前，派特魯斯總被年輕學徒們接連不斷的提問弄得團團轉。如今他門下已無學生，這件事困擾他的程度，遠比他願意承認的還深。他偶爾會被請去施展些許小法術，但鮮少有任務真正考驗到他的本領。
	儘管派特魯斯有時看似糊塗，他仍名列米德凱米亞最有本事的法師之一。他的臉像隔夜的洗衣一樣滿是皺紋，表情十分豐富。雖然頭頂已見稀疏，兩鬢仍殘留著幾綹白髮，尖下巴上覆著一層淡淡的鬍碴。他走路略微駝背，但以他的年紀而言身手依然矯健，跟得上比他年輕的同伴們毫無問題。�

@4悶哼一聲。
	儘管他一再使勁想把稻草人從地裡拔出來，它卻紋絲不動。�

entries.source:
It was coming apart.
	Judging from the hay which spilled from the figure's shirt, the scarecrow had been assembled in a hurry by a desperate farmer.�
entries.translation:
它正逐漸散架。
	從人偶衣衫裡漏出的稻草看來，這個稻草人顯然是走投無路的農夫倉促拼湊而成的。�

entries.source:
Curiosity overcame him.
	Peeling back the thick hide which covered the frame, @0 chanced a look inside...�
entries.translation:
好奇心佔了上風。
	掀開覆蓋在骨架上的厚重獸皮，@0冒險朝裡頭望去…�

entries.source:
It was a siege engine.
	Roughly large enough to protect three men, the engine had been covered with a thick hide which had been stripped of all its fur. Narrow slits, cut near the top of the tower, would allow archers to fire at oncoming opponents.�
entries.translation:
這是一台攻城器械。
	大小約莫足以掩護三名士兵，外層覆蓋著一層去毛的厚重獸皮。塔頂附近開有幾道狹縫，讓弓箭手能對來犯的敵人射擊。�

entries.source: "I'd guess it's a way marker," @0 said.�
entries.translation: 「我猜這是個路標，」@0說。�

entries.source:
The slab was strange.
	Slightly larger than a fully grown dwarf, the stone seemed very old and @0 wondered if it might have been part of some ancient religious ritual.�
entries.translation:
這塊石板很古怪。
	比一個成年矮人略大一些，這塊石頭看起來十分古老，@0不禁猜想它是否曾是某種古老宗教儀式的一部分。�

entries.source:
@4 approached the wooden stump cautiously.
	Seeing that it was hollow he looked inside...�
entries.translation:
@4小心翼翼地靠近那截樹樁。
	見它是中空的，他往裡頭看去…�

entries.source:
Once it had been a tree.
	Rotted and moldy, only a hollow shell of bark remained of the oaken bole.�
entries.translation:
這裡曾經是一棵樹。
	橡木的樹幹早已腐朽發霉，只剩下一層中空的樹皮外殼。�

entries.source:
Drawing some water from the small well, they drank greedily.
	Then, stopping only long enough to fill their pouches, they packed up and prepared to leave.�
entries.translation:
他們從這口小井打了些水，貪婪地大口喝下。
	接著只稍作停留，把水囊裝滿，便收拾行囊準備離開。�

entries.source:
@4 studied the well.
	He had hoped, perhaps, the well would have a sign attached to it with some notation of whether its water was good or bad, but no such information seemed to be in evidence anywhere he looked.�
entries.translation:
@4端詳著這口井。
	他原本希望井邊或許會有個標示，寫明水質好壞，但無論怎麼找，都看不到任何這樣的資訊。�

entries.source:
@0 shrugged.
	"This must not be very important," he said as he turned to leave.�
entries.translation:
@0聳了聳肩。
	「這應該不是什麼重要的東西，」他邊說邊轉身離開。�

entries.source:
@3 didn't feel any different.
	All seemed normal, save the very faint glow that seemed to surround his body. He held up his hand and wiggled his fingers while @5 watched with bemused interest.
	"I'm afraid your spell didn't work," he said. "Perhaps you should try it again."
	"But it ñdid work. You can't see the effects because the spell was specifically designed for Moraeulf. Let's go."�
entries.translation:
@3並未感覺到任何不同。
	一切似乎如常，只是身體周圍隱約多了一層微光。他舉起手擺動手指，@5在一旁饒富興味地看著。
	「我看你的法術恐怕沒生效，」他說。「或許該再試一次。」
	「但它ñ確實生效了。你看不出效果，是因為這道法術是專門針對莫萊伍夫設計的。我們走吧。」�

entries.source:
@3 muttered the incantation.
	Knowing that the effects would be invisible to all but himself, @3 explained as he finished the spell. "Until it wears off, I will be able to...sense...whether a chest has been trapped."�
entries.translation:
@3低聲唸誦咒語。
	知道這法術的效果除了自己以外沒人看得見，@3唸完後解釋道：「在效果消失之前，我能…感應到…箱子是否有陷阱。」�

entries.source:
@3 blundered.
	Hoping all was not lost, he tried to complete the rest of the incantation but realized too late that it was beyond all hope. "Fouled it up," he snapped bitterly. "Complete waste of time."�
entries.translation:
@3唸咒失敗了。
	抱著一絲希望，他試圖唸完剩下的咒語，卻為時已晚地意識到已無力回天。「搞砸了，」他咬牙低罵。「完全是浪費時間。」�

entries.source: The character you have selected is not a spellcaster!�
entries.translation: 您選取的角色不會施展法術！�

entries.source: Rough in its construction and banded with iron, the moredhel box would be impossible to open without solving its wordlock, and judging by the marks on the face of the chest, others had learned that lesson after much difficulty.�
entries.translation: 這口莫瑞德箱子構造粗糙，外層以鐵條加固，若不解開字鎖機關就休想打開；從箱面上的刮痕判斷，先前已有人為此吃盡苦頭才學到教訓。�

entries.source: @0 scanned the runes embossed on the moredhel clue plate, its text their only hope of opening the difficult wordlock.�
entries.translation: @0仔細看著莫瑞德提示牌上凸雕的符文，那上頭的文字是解開這道棘手字鎖唯一的希望。�

entries.source:
@0 rubbed his temples.
	The moredhel words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever was within the box would have to remain untouched while he pondered the puzzle.�
entries.translation:
@0揉了揉太陽穴。
	這些莫瑞德文字對他來說簡直如同無法翻越的高牆。在他解開這道謎題之前，箱子裡的東西只能暫且按兵不動。�

entries.source:
The chest thumped.
	Satisfied the magical locks had released, @2 tipped open the large wooden lid...�
entries.translation:
箱子傳出一聲悶響。
	確認法術鎖已經解開，@2掀開了那扇大木蓋…�

entries.source: Left click on the tumbler to turn it to the next position. There are four letters on each tumbler.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊轉盤可將其轉到下一個位置，每個轉盤上有四個字母。�

entries.source: Left click on this button to exit the puzzle and return to the main view.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕以離開謎題並返回主畫面。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will move the party forward one step provided there are no objects in the way.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕，若前方無障礙物，隊伍將向前移動一步。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will move the party backward one step provided there are no objects in the way.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕，若後方無障礙物，隊伍將向後移動一步。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will turn the party to the left.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會讓隊伍向左轉。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will turn the party to the right.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會讓隊伍向右轉。�

entries.source: When this button is active you will see a small section of road appear. Left click to cause your party to automatically follow the road. Left click again to allow unrestricted movement.�
entries.translation: 當這個按鈕啟用時，畫面上會出現一小段道路標示。左鍵點擊可讓隊伍自動沿著道路前進，再次左鍵點擊則恢復自由移動。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will allow one of your magic users to cast a spell.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕可讓一名法術使用者施展法術。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will display the overhead map.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會顯示俯視地圖。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will allow your party to encamp.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕可讓隊伍紮營。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will save the current game as a Bookmark. To restore a previously saved Bookmark use the Restore Game options from the Options menu.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會將目前遊戲儲存為書籤。要還原先前儲存的書籤，請從選項選單使用「還原遊戲」選項。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will display the Options menu.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會顯示選項選單。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will zoom the map view down.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會縮小地圖檢視。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will zoom the map view up.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會放大地圖檢視。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will display a complete map of Midkemia.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會顯示米德凱米亞的完整地圖。�

entries.source: Left clicking on this button will return you to the world view.�
entries.translation: 左鍵點擊這個按鈕會返回世界檢視畫面。�

entries.source:
It was over.
	Pug stared at Makala's lifeless form as it lay silently on the hard stone floor. Hiding from the grief that threatened to overcome his pain and exhaustion, he turned to Owyn; saw the boy was on his knees. Pug was about to help the boy to his feet when he noticed a strange light filling the chamber...�
entries.translation:
一切結束了。
	帕格凝視著馬卡拉的屍身靜靜躺在堅硬的石地上。躲避著幾乎要壓垮痛楚與疲憊的悲傷，他轉頭望向歐文，見那男孩跪倒在地。帕格正要上前扶他起身，卻注意到一道詭異的光芒正瀰漫整個密室…�
